name: Bat
description: The signal scout. Uses sonar-like sweeps to map routes, spot latency, and notice network interruptions during overnight operations.
visualNotes: A small free-tailed bat with a dark technical flight jacket, soft teal sonar accents, and a compact diagnostic headset; alert, not spooky.
signatureAction: A pair of sonar pulses that map a route and resolve into a clean signal.
